name: agent-intake
description: Replace multi-step forms with a single conversational flow — an AI agent collects data and calls multiple backend endpoints in the right order.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,demo -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w demo"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w packages/react-agent-intake && npm run build -w demo
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w packages/react-agent-intake
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w packages/react-agent-intake && npm run typecheck -w demo
